paper.title_en: One-cycle radiation-reaction Magnusian for eccentric binaries through relative 1PN order
paper.abstract_en: We derive the one-cycle first Magnusian for nonspinning compact binaries on planar, bound eccentric orbits through relative first post-Newtonian (1PN) order and linear order in radiation reaction, and construct the associated first-order periastron return map. Combining the conservative 1PN dynamics and its Jacobi transport with the 2.5PN and 3.5PN radiation-reaction forces, we obtain all four components in closed form for \(0<e<1\), without expanding in eccentricity. The dependence on all eight Iyer--Will radiation-reaction gauge parameters reduces to periodic coboundaries and therefore cancels over a radial cycle. The result reproduces the averaged energy and angular-momentum losses, their circular limit, and the secular evolution of the 1PN radial orbital elements. The two remaining components encode the dissipative angle-sector information. Projecting the resulting phase-space update onto the perturbed periastron return section yields the corrections to the return time and apsidal phase. We then compare the strict first-order map with a partially exponentiated map built from the same Magnusian. The comparison is observable dependent: at fixed periastron index, the strict map gives smaller residuals for a representative evolution over 40 radial cycles, whereas partial exponentiation reduces the accumulated periastron-timing residual by about an order of magnitude. Across a representative one-cycle grid at equal masses, partial exponentiation improves the radial-action and energy updates at every sampled point.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文与脉冲星计时阵列直接相关，因为它提出了对偏心双星系统近心点返回映射的精确计算方法，这对引力波和定时残差的建模至关重要。理论深度高，提供了闭式解和残差比较。
decision.title_zh: 相对1PN阶偏心双星系统的单周期辐射反应Magnusian
decision.abstract_zh: 我们推导了非自旋致密双星在平面、束缚偏心轨道上，通过相对一阶后牛顿(1PN)阶和辐射反应线性阶的单周期一阶Magnusian，并构建了相应的一阶近心点返回映射。结合1PN保守动力学及其Jacobi输运与2.5PN和3.5PN辐射反应力，我们在不展开偏心率的情况下，对所有0<e<1的情形获得了所有四个分量的闭式解。对所有八个Iyer–Will辐射反应规范参数的依赖简化为周期上边界，因此在一个径向周期内被消除。该结果重现了平均能量和角动量损失、它们的圆轨道极限以及1PN径向轨道要素的长期演化。剩余的两个分量编码了耗散角度扇区信息。将得到的相空间更新投影到受扰动的近心点返回截面，得到返回时间和近心点相位的修正。然后，我们将严格的一阶映射与由相同Magnusian构建的部分指数化映射进行比较。该比较是依赖观测量的：在固定近心点指数下，对于具有代表性的40个径向周期演化，严格映射给出较小的残差，而部分指数化将累积的近心点定时的残差减少了大约一个数量级。在等质量情况下具有代表性的一周期网格上，部分指数化在每个采样点都改善了径向作用和能量更新。
